Tormented by his memories, DUDE, a detective, employs his investigative talents to outwit the suspects, yet finds himself torn between his personal and work life.
DUDE's investigation reveals suspects' dark secrets and hidden truths, while tension rises as he nears solving the mystery, triggering events that uncover his past adventures.
Couples from Mumbai and Delhi face emotional dilemmas as their relationship with their partners and best friends are put to the test.
As Dude's mistrust of Mrs Pal grows and Mr Pal pulls his case from being investigated, Dude becomes more determined to expose the falsehood and intends to assist Mr Kumar against Pawa ji's wishes.
As his investigation continues, DUDE finds that there is more to the case than he thought. Soon, he becomes embroiled in a number of problems and must balance his personal and professional life.

In a crowded and chaotic medical facility, Trisha controls her emotions and maintains her composure while providing urgent assistance to a casualty. She perceives that the hostility of the parents originates from intense apprehension amidst this immense crisis.
With calmness and precision, Trisha performs a difficult procedure unassisted, saving the life of a man whose condition had turned critical.

Trisha chooses to go on a long leave from the medical facility in order to support and spend time with her family and near and dear ones. However, she promptly resumes her professional obligations during an unavoidable emergency to assist others with immense valour.
